title: Reset and dirty state
objective: Understand isDirty, dirtyFields, defaultValues, reset(), and preserving drafts after a failed request.
predict: After a 500 response, isDirty stays true and the typed title remains; after a 201 success, the form resets to its initial defaults.
expectedBehavior: Enter a nonempty title, force server 503, and verify the field remains dirty. Repeat with 201 and confirm reset clears it.
commonFailure: The starter resets before the HTTP response is confirmed, destroying user input on failure.
securityBoundary: Do not store private form drafts or server error bodies into telemetry by default; client state may contain sensitive data.
